title: Mythic Thor
description: Summon the god of thunder during storms! Wielding Mjölnir and dropping legendary rewards, this lightweight RPG addon creates a cinematic boss encounter with seamless cross-mod integration. Perfect for hardcore survival.
body:
**Description**
Summon the wrath of the storm. Face the god of thunder in your world. You can summon him during violent thunderstorms, wielding Mjölnir and dropping rare legendary rewards.                                         

Built for RPG and hardcore survival modpacks, this addon creates a cinematic boss encounter using seamless cross-mod integration. Lightweight, immersive, and fully integrated with existing mods.

To spawn the God of thunder, you will need to obtain a Totem of lightning, dropped by an illager boss in raids, and then you can summon him when there is a storm... and you right-click with the totem.

Thor is highly configurable thanks to Kube JS, allowing you to change values ​​and many other features (equipment, damage, effects, etc.) within kubejs\scripts\server_scripts\thor_spawn. Once you've made the changes, simply run /reload in-game, and everything will be updated.

Make sure to install Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks along with the other dependencies for it to function correctly.

**Required dependencies**:

- Kube JS
- Overgeared
- Scorched Guns 2
- Goety
- Born in Chaos
- Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
- Difficult Raids - Compatibility Edition
- Illager Additions
- Allurement
